headline: Canada Budget Watchdog Trims Economic Outlook Amid U.S. Tariffs
summary: Canada's Parliamentary Budget Office lowered its economic growth forecast for 2026 and 2027, citing new U.S. tariffs and domestic countermeasures.
why: Macroeconomic forecasts by national budget watchdogs provide institutional insights into fiscal health, directly influencing monetary policy decisions and currency strength.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: New trade barriers and tariffs weigh on projected national economic growth.
